title: JobList
description: Response shape of GET /api/admin/jobs (#251). The operator's window onto the universal delegation queue eidan.jobs (#247/#248): recent rows newest-first, capped server-side. The queue is a working set (terminal rows are not pruned here), so this is a recency-bounded snapshot, not the full history.

jobs.description: Recent jobs, newest first (by created_at), capped at the server's most-recent limit.

kind.description: The capability kind this job needs (e.g. 'code'). Routing is by kind, never by node.

goal.description: Human-readable task / brief the worker acts on.

status.description: Lifecycle state, matching the CHECK on eidan.jobs.status.

surface.description: Where the delegation originated ('web' | 'slack' | 'telegram' | 'agent' | …). Null when unrecorded.

claimed_by.description: node_id of the node that claimed the job. Null until claimed.

claimed_at.description: When the job was claimed. Null until claimed.

result.description: Worker output (e.g. {"pr_url": "…"}). Empty object when the job has no result yet or carried none.

error.description: Failure detail when status is 'failed'; null otherwise.
